description: This Java class implements a Redis-based registration store for LwM2M devices within the Thingsboard platform. It manages device registrations, observations, expiration, and cleanup tasks, utilizing Redis for persistence and synchronization.

classes.name: TbLwM2mRedisRegistrationStore
classes.description: A Redis-backed store for managing LwM2M device registrations, observations, and expiration cleanup within Thingsboard.

classes.name: Cleaner
classes.description: Inner class implementing periodic cleanup of expired registrations.

methods.name: addRegistration
methods.description: Adds or updates a device registration in Redis, managing secondary indexes and expiration.

methods.name: updateRegistration
methods.description: Updates an existing registration with new data.

methods.name: getRegistration
methods.description: Retrieves a registration by registration ID.

methods.name: getRegistrationByEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves a registration by device endpoint.

methods.name: getRegistrationByAdress
methods.description: Retrieves a registration by socket address.

methods.name: getRegistrationByIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves a registration by device identity.

methods.name: getAllRegistrations
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all registrations.

methods.name: removeRegistration
methods.description: Removes a registration and associated observations.

methods.name: addObservation
methods.description: Adds an observation for a registration, replacing existing if necessary.

methods.name: getObservations
methods.description: Retrieves all observations for a registration.

methods.name: getObservation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific observation by ID.

methods.name: removeObservations
methods.description: Removes all observations for a registration.

methods.name: setExpirationListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for registration expiration events.
